description: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets available for different languages over a period of years. The horizontal axis represents “Year,” with categories labeled 2012 through 2021, presented in ascending order. The vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets” and employs a logarithmic scale, ranging from 10⁰ to 10², with tick labels at intervals of 10⁰ and 10¹.  For each year, there are two bars: a blue bar representing “1” language and an orange bar representing “2+” languages. The blue bars generally increase in height from 2012 to 2021, starting at approximately 2 datasets in 2012 and reaching approximately 100 datasets in 2021. The orange bars also generally increase, beginning at approximately 1 dataset in 2012 and reaching approximately 20 datasets in 2021, though they are consistently shorter than the blue bars for each year. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each year, visually separating the dataset counts for single-language and multi-language datasets. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlines, or annotations.
